# Output fixtures

`NotoSansSC-CJK.subset.ttf.base64` is a two-glyph Google Fonts response for
“中文” from Noto Sans SC v40. Noto fonts are distributed under the
[SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/).
The fixture is intentionally source-encoded as base64 so repository text and
architecture checks remain deterministic.
